biography: Timothé Buret's journey began amidst the sun-drenched vineyards of Bordeaux, France, a world away from the roar of engines. His introduction to motorsports was accidental, a chance encounter with a go-kart track during a family holiday. The raw speed and visceral thrill ignited a passion that quickly consumed him. He traded the promise of a comfortable life in the family's wine business for the uncertainty of the racetrack. Early success in regional karting championships fueled his ambition, leading him to single-seaters and eventually endurance racing. Buret's ascent has been marked by both exhilarating victories and painful setbacks, including a near-fatal crash in a Formula Renault race that left him sidelined for months. Now, at 25, Buret is carving out a reputation for himself in the challenging world of endurance racing with Ligier JS P217, hoping to make a name for himself.
drivingStyle: Buret's driving style is characterized by a relentless pursuit of speed and an aggressive approach to overtaking. He's known for late-braking maneuvers and a willingness to push the car to its absolute limit, often flirting with the edge of control. Tire management isn't always his strongest suit, as his aggressive style tends to punish the rubber, but his sheer pace can often compensate. When the pressure is on, Buret thrives, relishing the opportunity to battle wheel-to-wheel.
rivalries: Marco Visconti: A long-standing rivalry stemming from their karting days, where Visconti accused Buret of overly aggressive tactics.
Isabelle Dubois: A competitor in the same endurance racing series, their rivalry is fueled by contrasting driving styles – Dubois' precise, calculated approach versus Buret's raw aggression.
Ricardo Alves: An on-track incident at Le Mans in which Alves claimed Buret pushed him off the track created immediate and intense animosity.
quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks given to him by his grandmother before every race.
Listens to a specific obscure French techno song on repeat in the hour leading up to the race start.
Refuses to shave on race weekends, believing it brings bad luck.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about being safe; it's about being faster than the guy next to you. And sometimes, that means taking risks."
careerHighlight: Winning the 24 Hours of Daytona in the LMP2 class after a thrilling last-lap battle, securing his first major international victory.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final hour of the 24 Hours of Le Mans due to a mechanical failure, denying his team a potential victory.
